row.title: Probes must name their user agent
row.body: Session: session_0156nqDte8FeqRLjvGRAAb6w. Cloudflare returns 403 to Python-urllib, so every spinoff read uptime 0.0 while live (route, DNS and worker verified in the ultrastable account). The foundation package now installs a default opener with a named agent; Q-ULTRA-loop-ledger-uptime-* close when the next tick reads 1.0.
